tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List all available video/audio processing tools with their options

tools.name: create_job
tools.description: Create a video/audio processing job. Use list_tools first to find the right tool and options. Returns a job ID — use get_job to check status and get the result URL.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Check the status of a processing job. When status is 'completed', the response includes a download URL valid for 1 hour.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a queued or processing job. Reserved credits are refunded.
